stem.zh-CN: 相比于[[term:self-attention|单头注意力]]，[[term:multi-head-attention|多头注意力（Multi-Head Attention, MHA）]]的核心优势在于?
stem.en-US: Compared with [[term:self-attention|single-head attention]], what is the core advantage of [[term:multi-head-attention|multi-head attention (MHA)]]?

explanation.zh-CN: 多头注意力能从多个子空间捕获不同关系。
explanation.en-US: Multi-head attention can capture different relationships in multiple representation subspaces.

primaryConcept.zh-CN: 多头注意力的表示子空间与关系建模
primaryConcept.en-US: Representation subspaces and relation modeling in multi-head attention

text.zh-CN: 减少推理阶段的 [[term:kv-cache|KV Cache]] 显存占用
text.en-US: Reduce [[term:kv-cache|KV Cache]] memory usage during inference

text.zh-CN: 允许模型在不同的表示子空间中并行关注来自不同位置的信息
text.en-US: Allow the model to attend to information from different positions in parallel across different representation subspaces

text.zh-CN: 能够显著降低模型的总体参数量
text.en-US: Significantly reduce the model's total parameter count

text.zh-CN: 能够彻底消除序列处理中的位置依赖问题
text.en-US: Completely eliminate positional dependence in sequence processing
